name: synaptory
description: Native Synaptory delivery orchestration for Codex with deterministic lifecycle and receipt gates.

interface.shortDescription: Run governed Synaptory delivery in Codex.
interface.longDescription: A native Codex host package for Synaptory projects. It composes the shared lifecycle and receipt runtime, installs nine project-scoped role profiles, and runs fail-closed story execution selected by deterministic state-machine actions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $synaptory to inspect readiness and continue governed Synaptory delivery with Codex agents.
